newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-TWO ROMANIAN PLAYERS DIE IN ROAD ACCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO ROMANIAN PLAYERS DIE IN ROAD ACCIDENT.

text.p: Two players of Romanian first division soccer club F.C. Chindia Tirgoviste have been killed in a road crash, a club official said on Sunday.

Spokesman Tinel Aldea said midfielder Bogdan Lita and goalkeeper Cristian Igescu died on Saturday night when their car struck a tree and burst into flames after colliding head on with another vehicle.

He said the pair had been travelling from Tirgoviste to Bucharest after playing in their side's 1-1 draw away to Universitatea Craiova. Lita, 20, had played regularly for Chindia and Igescu, 23, was a substitute.
